status: 18 unexecuted native gates; proposed controls are not acceptance

gates.title: Actual element identities
gates.requirement: For named/anonymous roots and terminals, preserve D, T, G and atomic date/alias A; assert G differs from A for complex content and no fabricated QName.

gates.title: Both original-node compiler paths
gates.requirement: Exercise flat-root and nested-terminal plans with real NativeSchemaProvider/Input and data($node), never a synthetic date validator.

gates.title: Both public facades
gates.requirement: ReadRootScalar/ReadScalar and ReadElement/ReadAttribute preserve checked Date and existing root/leaf/scalar/attribute contracts.

gates.title: Shared components and owners
gates.requirement: Shared C across roots/terminals has shared type identity but distinct original declarations, owner paths and facts; independent sessions remain foreign.

gates.title: Attribute closure including zero uses
gates.requirement: Date extension ordinary undeclared attributes are Invalid even with zero uses; special xsi/xml exclusions remain Unsupported; other profile behavior unchanged.

gates.title: Typed attribute values and namespace forms
gates.requirement: Check string/Boolean/integer/date attributes, required/optional, qualified/unqualified names, declaration indexing and original owner nodes.

gates.title: Calendar and lexical fidelity
gates.requirement: Reuse checked year zero/negative/extended/bounded dates, timezone absence/zero/offset, XML whitespace and invalid calendar behavior without DateTimeOffset.

gates.title: Complex selection boundary
gates.requirement: Exact same complex xsi:type works; absent/unrelated/base selections are Invalid; valid simple-to-complex substitution stays Unsupported.

gates.title: Decimal fallback refusal
gates.requirement: Unused or used date complex restrictions are Unsupported before noninteger decimal facet handling; no accidental facet or chain admission.

gates.title: Eager declarations and source graph
gates.requirement: Unused unsupported definitions, forward primitive aliases, unknown/cyclic complex bases and source counts are checked before publication.

gates.title: Expanded budgets
gates.requirement: Per-owner attributes16, expanded attributes64, scalars16, nodes64 and depth4; check17/65/17/65/5 separately with no discarded uses.

gates.title: Cancellation and recovery
gates.requirement: Pre-cancel compile/assess/read/export and operation cancellation remain distinct from input outcomes; failed admissions do not leak quotas.

gates.title: Atomic failed publication
gates.requirement: Invalid date/attributes and Unsupported capacities publish neither partial successful facts nor snapshots.

gates.title: Export/reopen
gates.requirement: Export preserves parsed date lexical text, attributes, names and original physical structure; reopening produces equivalent checked values.

gates.title: Disposal and detached lifetime
gates.requirement: Document/session/input/facts after disposal refuse; detached date and attribute values survive with no origin/authority transfer.

gates.title: Signed package-only Core identities
gates.requirement: Run actual native candidate on signed Core1.81.2 and1.81.17, verifying exact archive/runtime/source pins and preserving Core dependency direction.

gates.title: Unchanged regression and API boundary
gates.requirement: Run all original cases before reconciliation; record measured expectation changes without stimulus removal; verify zero public API delta rather than assume it.

gates.title: Legacy and delivery boundaries
gates.requirement: Legacy decimal date grammar remains refused. Full source/package/native/retained/example/corpus gates precede delivery; full PSVI/C45/public closure/performance stay separate.
